lines.t: You know the parts I never spoke
Held back until my floodgates broke
False guides took me far away
From your grace that I know today
Now teachers make me clench my jaw
Hold fiercely, stand alone, be small
You heard my breath go quick and thin
Still bruised from what fake shepherds spin
You didn't scold my trembling knees
You didn't wait for me to plead
My heart was stirred at your roar, I recognize and fear no more
You sent the lions, I braced for teeth, you gave a rain where the drought ran deep
Your shelter in the height of heat, it is the sound of your heartbeat
You sent the lions, they don't want pay Like doves, they sing your song all day
You just, you made my hands unclench I can lean now, I don't have to flinch
You saw the tear I tried to hide Found scattered where the wild wheat lies
Refined and broken, your tears we cried A ten-year drought broke wide inside
You must have smiled to watch me pause At how I checked for the hidden cost
You know I'm learning inch by inch That being held is not being lost
You didn't scold my trembling knees You didn't wait for me to plead
My heart was stirred at your roar I recognize and fear no more
You sent the lions out braced for teeth You gave a rain where the drought ran deep
You shelter in the height of heat It is the sound of your heartbeat
You sent the lions, they don't want pay Like doves, they sing your song all day
You just, you made my hands unclench I can lean now, I don't have to flinch
You can keep this just you and me You saw the panic, none could see
12,000 sealed from every tribe 12 times 12,000 at my side
You sent the lions, I braced for teeth You gave a rain where the drought ran deep
You shelter in the height of heat
It is the sound of your heartbeat
You sent the lions, they don't want pay
Like doves, they sing your song all day
You just, you made my hands unclench
I can lean now, I don't have to flinch
You sent them near, you stayed right here
You sent them near, your second harvest found in me
You sent them near, you stayed right here
You sent them near, your second harvest found in me
